description: Coordinates a linear signing ceremony over document pages and signing field steps. Active-steps contract (Signing redesign phase 6, S2-5/SI2 — opt-in): with OnSendPhoneCode / OnVerifyPhoneCode / OnAttachmentSelected / OnExternalStepRequested wired, the phone OTP, the attachment upload and the external verification are confirmed by the HOST — a phone step completes only after the host verifier answers true, the attachment card carries the host-returned upload url, and an external step completes only after the host stores the provider result (value true) through Values. Without the callbacks the documented legacy behaviour stands (the click stores true, the typed phone completes the step, uploads stay client-side), so completion of those steps is presentation state, never proof that a verification, payment, or upload happened.

parameters.name: DocumentHeaderActions
parameters.description: Host actions rendered in the document header row next to DocumentTitle (Signing redesign phase 3, U4) — for example a language or metadata control the host owns.

parameters.name: DocumentTitle
parameters.description: Optional document title shown above the pages (Signing redesign phase 3, U4). Rendered only when set (or when DocumentHeaderActions has content), so the default look stays today's chrome-free document area.

parameters.name: Pages
parameters.description: Document pages shown during signing.

parameters.name: ShowDocumentToolbar
parameters.description: Shows the document toolbar's ZOOM controls on every page viewer (Signing redesign phase 3, U4). The zoom level is SHARED across all pages through the runner's own scale state. Pagination controls stay off — the runner presents one page at a time, so per-page previous/next buttons would be dead chrome (they come with a later phase if a host needs them). Defaults to false — today's chrome-free look.

parameters.name: AutoSaveDelay
parameters.description: Delay before autosave is invoked after a value change.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to render the signing layer.

parameters.name: CultureChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the signing culture changes.

parameters.name: DefaultSignatureMode
parameters.description: The capture mode a signature step STARTS in when the template's Preferences.Format is silent (Signing redesign phase 5, SI3). Auto — the default — resolves to Draw on a coarse pointer (a finger) and to Typed elsewhere; the template's stored format always wins over this setting.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when field translations are missing.

parameters.name: Fields
parameters.description: Signing fields available to the signer.

parameters.name: IsCompleting
parameters.description: Whether the complete action is currently running.

parameters.name: IsLoading
parameters.description: Whether navigation and inputs are currently blocked by an external operation.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: The layout the runner renders (Signing redesign phase 5). Auto measures the runner's own container — a container narrower than the mobile breakpoint presents the steps rail as the bottom sheet (peek / expanded) with radio-card choice fields (SI1); wider containers keep the docked desktop panel. A forced value never measures, so a test (or a host that already knows the width) can pin the presentation without a DOM.

parameters.name: MobileCompleteTargetSelector
parameters.description: Optional selector for a fixed complete target that the mobile panel must avoid.

parameters.name: MobilePanelMode
parameters.description: Initial presentation mode for the mobile bottom panel.

parameters.name: OnAttachmentSelected
parameters.description: Host upload hook for attachment fields (Signing redesign phase 6, S2-5, opt-in). The runner hands the picked IBrowserFile over and stores the RETURNED url on the attachment card; a null result (or a throwing host, cancellation aside) REJECTS the file with the localized failure message. Security: read the file content in the HOST (File.OpenReadStream) — never rely on the component to do it — because on Blazor Server browser files stream over SignalR with tight message limits, so a large upload must be consumed (and ideally persisted) by the server, in one pass. The step-side MaxFileSize limit is a CLIENT-REPORTED courtesy (the browser's declared size) — the host MUST enforce the real limit via OpenReadStream(maxAllowedSize). Without the hook the picked files stay client-side metadata (the documented placeholder behaviour).

parameters.name: OnAutoSave
parameters.description: Callback invoked after debounced autosave.

parameters.name: OnComplete
parameters.description: Callback invoked when all required fields are complete and the signer completes the form.

parameters.name: OnExternalStepRequested
parameters.description: Host hook raised when the signer starts an external flow — verification, KBA answer submission or payment (Signing redesign phase 6, SI2, opt-in). The request carries the field and, for KBA, the typed answers (which are never stored as the field value). With this hook wired the runner stores NOTHING on the click: the step completes solely after the host performs the provider flow and stores the result (value true or the string "true") through Values. Without the hook the legacy behaviour keeps storing true on the click — presentation state, never proof that a verification or payment happened.

parameters.name: OnLocalizationSnapshotChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked with a resolved localization snapshot for audit storage.

parameters.name: OnSendPhoneCode
parameters.description: Host hook that dispatches the OTP code for a phone field (Signing redesign phase 6, S2-5, opt-in). Raised with the normalized number every time the signer sends or resends a code; the runner itself never dispatches an SMS. Without the callback the phone step keeps the documented cosmetic behaviour (nothing is sent).

parameters.name: OnStepSubmit
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the current step is submitted by moving forward.

parameters.name: OnVerifyPhoneCode
parameters.description: Host hook that verifies the typed OTP code (Signing redesign phase 6, S2-5, opt-in). Returning true is the ONLY way a phone field completes while this hook is wired — the runner records the confirmation (runner-internal, bound to the VERIFIED number, never part of Values) and shows the verified state; false shows the localized invalid-code message with the error owned by the OTP input. A throwing verifier shows the localized unavailable message and never records a confirmation. Security: the host owns RATE LIMITING and ATTEMPT COUNTING, and because the confirmation is runner-internal (not persisted), a RESUMED session must re-verify — keep your own record host-side. Without the hook, today's behaviour stands: the typed phone number alone completes the step (no code is ever checked).

parameters.name: ResolvedLayoutChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the resolved layout changes. The initial value is not a change. Never pair LayoutMode with this callback: it reports the resolved mode, and a two-way bind would pin that mode.

parameters.name: ShowLanguageSelector
parameters.description: Whether the runner should show a language selector when multiple cultures are available.

parameters.name: StepContextProvider
parameters.description: Provider context for an external field, resolved per render (Signing redesign phase 6, SI2, opt-in): the provider page url, the inline KBA questions, the loading state, the provider error and the provider display name. The CONTEXT never confirms the step — only the stored provider result does; return null to keep the step's own defaults.

parameters.name: SubmitterUuid
parameters.description: Optional signer role filter.

parameters.name: SubmitterRoles
parameters.description: Submitter roles whose colours are painted on the field overlays (RoleColor). The colour resolves from the field's own submitter, falling back to SubmitterUuid; roles without a colour keep the primary-tint overlay default.

parameters.name: SupportedCultures
parameters.description: Supported cultures offered by the language selector.

parameters.name: Values
parameters.description: Current field values keyed by field UUID.

parameters.name: ValuesChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked whenever field values change.
